 Negeri Sembilan vs Kuching City Prediction: Kuching’s Away Record Favours a Draw
 Finished 20/11/2026 08:45 Malaysia Super League Negeri Sembilan vs Kuching City 20.11.2026 
 Anastasia Dudkina 19/11/2026 16:43 Statistics of the month: 162 142 3 52.77 % ROI:   -0.09 % Statistics Odds Bet Type Bookmaker Claim Bonus! Odds 2,24 Bet Type Double Chance: 1X Bookmaker Bonus 100 € Bet now! Negeri Sembilan vs Kuching City: Prediction for the match on November 20, 2026
 Negeri Sembilan are five league matches without a win and sit in the lower half on 5 points. Kuching City are third on 12 points heading into matchday 7 of the Malaysia Super League. They meet at Stadium Tuanku Abdul Rahman in Paroi, Seremban. 
 Receive Your Welcome Bonus! Negeri Sembilan: Form and statistics
 In their most recent league game, Negeri Sembilan suffered a 3-1 defeat on the road against DPMM FC Brunei. Both sides went into the break level at 1-1, and while Negeri Sembilan had 56% of the ball, they managed the same number of shots as their opponents (8). DPMM FC Brunei had four of those on target, while Negeri Sembilan had three.
 Prior to the trip to DPMM FC Brunei, Negeri Sembilan played out a 1-1 draw at home against Sabah FC and suffered a 3-0 defeat on the road against Johor Darul Ta’zim. Before those games, they beat Kelantan City 3-2 at home in the FA Cup and drew 2-2 with Star City FC, also at home. They played a closed-door friendly during the international break to maintain match fitness and work on their tactical weaknesses ahead of the clash against Kuching City. 
 Negeri Sembilan: Lineup
 Three Negeri players were reported injured before the DPMM trip: forward Mio Tsuneyasu with a knee injury, Ryaan Sanizal and Wai Lin Aung. Their availability and any replacements are unconfirmed. The 4-3-3 is a projection.
 I wouldn’t assume Negeri will rearrange their front three: Tsuneyasu’s availability is still open, and the projection doesn’t establish who would take his place if he misses out. 
 Expected XI: Park Yi-Young, Yusuke Minagawa, Kei Oshiro, Yuichi Hirano, Takumi Sasaki, Akhyar Abdul Rashid, Hairiey Hakim Mamat, Z. Jamil, L. Hakim, S. Adib, Adam Azizol
 Kuching City: Form and statistics
 In their most recent game, Kuching City secured a 1-0 home victory over Selangor in the FA Cup to reach the final. Both sides went into the break level at 0-0, and while Kuching City had 65% of the ball, they managed only two more shots than their opponents (14 to 12). Selangor finished the game with ten men.
 Before the cup return, Kuching City beat Gangwon FC 2-0 at home in the AFC Champions League Two after suffering a 1-0 defeat on the road against the same opponents. Before those games, they lost 2-1 away to Selangor in the FA Cup and suffered a 3-2 defeat on the road against DPMM FC Brunei in the league. Both Negeri Sembilan and Kuching City have had plenty of the ball in individual matches, but neither side can count on possession at Paroi. 
 Kuching City: Lineup
 Kuching have two expected absentees: striker Ronald Ngah, whose knee injury required surgery, and centre-back Gabriel Peres, who is injured. Neither has a confirmed replacement in the projected 4-1-4-1. Petrus Shitembi has trained after missing Namibia’s squad.
 I can still see Shitembi getting the ball into the striker’s feet. Without a confirmed replacement for Peres, I wouldn’t assume Kuching will change how their centre-backs defend. 
 Expected XI: Haziq Nadzli, Ariff Farhan Isa, James Okwuosa, Ryan Lambert, Yuki Tanigawa, Kaishu Yamazaki, Ramadhan Saifullah, Safawi Rasid, Petrus Shitembi, João Pedro, Jerome Mpacko Etame
 Negeri Sembilan vs Kuching City: Head-to-head statistics
 Kuching City won 2-0 at home in the latest meeting and have won three times and drawn twice in the last five meetings. In the previous meeting at Paroi, Negeri Sembilan came back from two goals down to draw 2-2 with Kuching City, with Luis Enrique scoring the equaliser in stoppage time.

 Kuching City have scored fewer than three goals in all of their last five matches, and Negeri Sembilan have conceded fewer than three goals in three of their last five matches. Kuching City to score fewer than three goals is priced at 1.42 at 1xBet. 
 Three of Negeri Sembilan’s last five matches have reached four goals, but four of Kuching City’s last five matches have had fewer than four goals. Fewer than four goals in the match is priced at 1.44 at Betway. 
 Negeri Sembilan vs Kuching City match prediction, November 20, 2026
 Neither Negeri Sembilan nor Kuching City’s projected line-up gives either side a clear edge. Negeri Sembilan have conceded 11 goals in their last five matches, but Kuching City have not kept an away clean sheet in that stretch, so there is room for Negeri Sembilan to reply. Our predicted score: Negeri Sembilan 1-1 Kuching City.
 Negeri Sembilan can avoid defeat in this one, having done so in three of their last five matches, while Kuching City have failed to win three of their last five. Kuching City have the advantage in the league, but they have lost three consecutive away matches, and Negeri Sembilan have had a longer break between competitive fixtures. Kuching scored no more than once in 3 of their last 5 matches. Negeri conceded no more than once in only 1 of their last 5, but Kuching scored just three goals across their latest three matches, so the forecast gives them one here. Fewer than three goals is my boldest call in this one, considering that only one of Negeri Sembilan's last five matches has produced under 2.5 goals. However, three of Kuching City's last five matches have produced fewer than three goals, and they have scored six and conceded six in those five matches, so it's not just about how much they score.
